content:
“Daily Show” correspondent Jordan Klepper mockingly celebrated a recent report from the Drug Enforcement Administration, which showed President Donald Trump’s extrajudicial killings of alleged drug smugglers have done little to curb the import of cocaine into the U.S.

“Hell, yeah! Let’s fucking go! Whoo!” Klepper said in response to the report. “I mean: Another policy failure from the Trump administration. Somehow, the cocaine in America is not only still plentiful, but, according to DEA officials and my stockbroker, Cody, it’s that good shit.”

Klepper then questioned how blowing up “random fishing boats” has not stopped the flow of illicit drugs into the country, before playing a NewsNation clip that noted smugglers have found new ways to circumvent the United States’ tactics.

“Of course, drug lords found new ways,” Klepper said. “These are the same people who found a way to sneak in a powder using your butt. They’re pretty good at problem-solving.”

According to a report from NPR, Trump’s strikes on alleged drug boats have killed at least 200 people. The administration has presented little evidence to the public about what the boats are carrying onboard.
